messages:
marina: Heads-up — canary for sable-v1 (int8 PTQ) is showing a jump in funcall/JSON parse failures on our structured-output suite. Failing rate ~8.4% vs ~0.9% on raven-ptq baseline. Posting a failing sample below.

sam: ack, can you paste an example payload so we can repro locally?

marina: sure, here's one of the raw model responses (truncated array + trailing comma):
```
Expected schema: {
  "action": string,
  "args": [ {"id":int, "payload":{...}} ]
}
Model output: {"action": "create", "args": [ {"id": 42, "payload": {"name": "foo"}, }, ]
```

devon: looks like suffix trimming from kv-prefix batching + int8 attention noise — we saw similar non-terminated arrays when the kvprefix hit the 512 token boundary. Also some early EOS tokens slipping in. Can repro with smaller seeds.

tia: I think this lines up with the kvcache prefix change on the sable canary — last week we flipped `enable_kvprefix: true` for perf.

ana: (typo) ana: ops-bot shows recent deploy change in case that helps:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: sable-v1-int8-canary deployed by @marina — rollout 10%

devon: propose immediate mitigation: add a runtime "parse-circuitbreaker" — if parse-failure-rate > 3% over a 5m window, stop routing to the int8 path and fallback to the int16 mirror. For first failure, route the response to `json_repair` microservice before returning to the caller.

marina: +1. Also suggest tightening the retry policy for structured outputs to avoid repeated malformed outputs being retried and producing more bad responses: backoff `0.2s, 0.5s, 1.0s` and cap retries at 2.

sam: can we add telemetry tag `canary:sablev1-int8` on these eval calls and emit token-level trace for failed parses? need to correlate with sequence length and prefix size.

tia: I'll add the config change to the canary and a rollout plan note. PR incoming: #4023 (will link here when ready).

devon: also add a nightly sampled eval run — run the structured-output harness against 5k examples and alert if delta > 1% vs baseline. That gives us automated guardrails.

ana: ana: I'll open a ticket for infra to make sure `json_repair` autoscaling and quota are ready if it gets >5% routing traffic.

marina: plan summary: 1) enable circuitbreaker threshold 3% over 5m; 2) fallback to int16 mirror when triggered; 3) route first-failure responses to `json_repair` service; 4) change retry backoff to `0.2,0.5,1.0` and max retries 2; 5) attach telemetry tag + nightly 5k eval. I'll drive execution.

sam: tagging @eng-sre for infra watchers :eyes:

eng-sre: we'll standby. If you flip the circuitbreaker we'll watch latency and error budgets and be ready to roll it back.

marina: thanks — I'll post PR link in this thread and ping again when the canary config is updated. :rocket:
